subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Trigonometry

outcomes.text: identify the sides of a right-angled triangle in relation to a particular angle,
determine the sine, cosine and tangent of acute angles in a right-angled triangle,
relate sines and cosines of complementary angles,
apply trigonometric ratios to angles of elevation and depression,
recognise the use of trigonometry in real-life situations.

content: Sines and Cosines of complementary angles
Application of trigonometric ratios (angle of elevation and depression)
coreCompetencies:
Self-efficacy: The learner makes observations and establishes the relationships between the sine and cosine ratios.
Learning to learn: The learner learns collaboratively while making a simple clinometer using locally available materials and using it as a learning resource.
values: Love: The learner demonstrates a caring attitude to others when using a simple clinometer to measure the angle of elevation and depression of different objects in the immediate environment.
pcis: Self-esteem: The learners acquire self-esteem while making a simple clinometer using locally available materials and use it as a learning resource.
transcription_policy: Source wording retained;line breaks/bullets normalised;source pixels authority.
notes: Tangent is required by outcomeb despite content heading focusing sines/cosines.
Source project requires actual clinometer making and use for elevation/depression;safe indoor accessible targets and separate actual-action observation are supplied.
